patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (his mother) He informed me he put a raisin in there to keep it safe. He is extremely pleased with himself. I can actually see it.
presentation.triageNote: Three-year-old male with a visible raisin in the external ear canal placed an hour ago, with no pain or bleeding.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this visible organic ear-canal foreign body requires one removal procedure.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This toddler has a recent raisin in the external ear canal without pain, bleeding, or deeper injury.
clinical.acuityReason: This visible organic ear-canal foreign body requires one removal procedure.
teachingPoints: One procedure, one resource. Never irrigate an organic foreign body — a raisin or a bean swells with water and becomes far harder to remove.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Careful dry removal and canal reassessment would allow discharge; irrigation should be avoided because organic material can swell.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 3-year-old boy in a striped t-shirt, sitting on a blue padded clinic chair with his legs sticking straight out
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with legs straight out in front of him, swinging his feet, pointing proudly at one ear
signs: one small finger pointing at his own ear
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 3-year-old boy in a striped t-shirt, sitting on a blue padded clinic chair with his legs sticking straight out. Pose: sitting with legs straight out in front of him, swinging his feet, pointing proudly at one ear. Expression: delighted with himself, entirely untroubled. Clearly visible: one small finger pointing at his own ear; a broad pleased grin. Overall: completely well and thoroughly pleased. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
